coordinates.note: No official LSM page fetched in this session states a numeric coordinate; this is an OpenStreetMap/Nominatim node specifically tagged as the laboratory itself (not a generic address geocode), but per A17 a geocoder source still limits kind to campus/approximate rather than underground_lab.
coordinates.quote: "name": "Laboratoire Souterrain de Modane (LSM)", lat 45.1962509, lon 6.6667021, 1125 Route de Bardonneche, Modane, Savoie, France

summary.plain: A laboratory carved into the rock in the middle of a road tunnel through the Alps, under 1700 metres of mountain, near Modane, France.
summary.technical: Underground experimental hall mid-way through the Frejus road tunnel (Modane, Savoie), under ~1700 m of rock; address Carre Sciences, 1125 route de Bardonneche, 73500 Modane.
